name: Spotlight Card

borderGlow.description: Also brighten the border ring under the pointer.

touch.description: Track touch pointers too (off by default; touch has no hover).

a11y: The spotlight and border-ring layers are decorative pseudo-elements, so they are not in the accessibility tree.
:focus-within shows the same centred glow as pointer hover, so keyboard users get equivalent feedback.
The host's own focus outline is untouched by the pseudo-element layers.
The default colour's alpha (0.12) keeps card text contrast; a custom colour should stay at or below roughly 0.2 alpha for the same reason.
